about.heading: Meticulous. Trustworthy. Yours.
body: Maid & Marble is a woman-owned house cleaning company serving Central Massachusetts — Worcester County, MetroWest, and towns along the I-495 corridor. We bring hotel-level attention to residential spaces: consistent crews, clear communication, and finishes that feel as polished as marble.

You work directly with the owner. We walk through your home, agree on scope and frequency, and show up ready to deliver. Licensed and insured. No surprise upsells — just reliable, detail-oriented cleaning.
